proof_summary: Introduce companion sequences \(c,s\) satisfying the same second-order recurrence and prove their addition formula and norm identity \(c_n^2+15s_n^2=64^n\), alongside the recurrence-derived formula \(2a_n=4\cdot8^n-4\cdot(-8)^n+c_{n+1}\). At an odd index, the power terms combine to \(64^{n+1}\), while the doubling formula gives \(c_{2n+2}=c_{n+1}^2-15s_{n+1}^2\); the norm identity then yields \(a_{2n+1}=c_{n+1}^2\).
